name: forge-agent-tree
description: Side pane that shows the session's agents as a live tree: models, status, activity, context, advisor calls and a short event log. Switch the session's model, effort and advisor from the pane, choose what new subagents get, and switch a running one; in 23 languages.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when an interactive session starts (Claude Code seats it only in a wide terminal)

animate.title: Motion
animate.description: The spinner while Claude works; a light running along the bars and a pulse down every line of the tree, idle too

columns.title: Width
columns.description: Columns the docked pane asks for; a width dragged by hand wins

logRows.title: Log rows
logRows.description: How many log rows the pane shows (0 to 20; the narrow view at most one); 0 hides the log

limitWarnAt.title: Limits: yellow from
limitWarnAt.description: The share (%) of the session or all-models limit from which its bar turns yellow

limitAlertAt.title: Limits: red from
limitAlertAt.description: The share (%) of the session or all-models limit from which its bar turns red; above the yellow one

bandLine.title: Line above the prompt
bandLine.description: While the pane is closed, a line above the prompt sums up the agents, drawn as token-weather draws its own

advisorSound.title: Advisor sound
advisorSound.description: A short sound at each advisor call: a chime on macOS, two beeps on Windows (through PowerShell), nothing on Linux

autoUpdate.title: Auto-update
autoUpdate.description: Once a day, at an interactive start, a copy installed from a marketplace reads the version on GitHub and, when it is newer, runs claude plugin update (see PRIVACY.md)
